source.content: List<String> empty = new List<String>(); System.assertEquals(0, empty.size()); List<String> source = new List<String>(); source.add('alpha'); source.add('beta'); List<String> copied = new List<String>(source); System.assertEquals(2, copied.size()); System.assertEquals('beta', copied.get(1)); Set<String> sourceSet = new Set<String>(); sourceSet.add('gamma'); sourceSet.add('delta'); List<String> fromSet = new List<String>(sourceSet); System.assertEquals(2, fromSet.size()); System.assert(fromSet.contains('gamma')); System.assert(fromSet.contains('delta')); System.assertNotEquals(null, copied.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, copied.toString()); Set<String> emptySet = new Set<String>(); System.assertEquals(0, emptySet.size()); Set<String> fromList = new Set<String>(source); System.assertEquals(2, fromList.size()); Set<String> copiedSet = new Set<String>(sourceSet); System.assertEquals(2, copiedSet.size()); Set<String> additions = new Set<String>(); additions.add('epsilon'); additions.add('zeta'); System.assertEquals(true, copiedSet.addAll(additions)); System.assertEquals(true, copiedSet.containsAll(additions)); Set<String> removal = new Set<String>(); removal.add('epsilon'); System.assertEquals(true, copiedSet.removeAll(removal)); System.assertEquals(false, copiedSet.contains('epsilon')); System.assertNotEquals(null, copiedSet.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, copiedSet.toString());
